settings.scope: Independent log-mole multi-equation equilibrium at60digits, source h/s recomposition, elemental and KKT conditions. Trace-relative comparison is required for every positive gas species; no concentration floor.

model_parameters.scope: Restricted equilibrium with pure reference graphite and ideal CO/CO2/O2/N2. No finite char chemistry or ignition dynamics.

scope: Independent source quadrature and simultaneous log-mole elemental/chemical-potential equations for selected states. Model decoder and scalar/quadratic roots are not reused in the reference. No rate law or time trajectory.
